Downloads the recognition model (about 490 MB) from Hugging Face. Press again to cancel.
Downloads the models that translate into the chosen language on this PC (60 to 240 MB each). Press again to cancel. The sources and licenses of the models:

How sentences are translated. Service: the translation service set in Preferences > Chat (the text goes to it). This PC: with models fetched here (English into Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Italian, Portuguese; Japanese into English); nothing is sent anywhere.
The language sentences are translated into. The first one: the language the chat translation uses (Preferences > Chat).
Translations into Japanese can be written in a dialect (a game; only the translated text changes, never what was spoken).

Listens to the sound of the stream player only, so nothing else is mixed in. It does not connect to the station a second time. Sentences are cut by loudness, and music can give wrong text. Windows 10 version 2004 or later.
How many processor threads recognition uses. More is quicker; fewer is lighter. Applies when this window is opened again.
The language spoken. Auto finds it out for each sentence (slower, and less exact). Applies when this window is opened again.
RmlUi is not used in safe mode.
